bio.text: Tammy Story is a Democrat who represents District 25 (Jefferson County) in the Colorado House of Representatives, where she took office on January 9, 2023; Ballotpedia lists her as running for re-election in 2026.
Ballotpedia lists her prior office as the Colorado State Senate, District 16, from 2019 to 2023.

It says her career experience includes work as a speech pathologist, as mountain area lead of the 2015 Jeffco Public Schools recall campaign, and in an advisory role to Jeffco Public Schools administrators and school boards.
